Palestinian protester Leqaa Kordia has been released from ICE detention after more than a year in custody.  Kordia, a New Jersey resident originally from the West Bank, was the last protester still being held following the Trump administration’s crackdown on pro-Palestinian campus demonstrations.  She had been detained since March 2025 at a detention center in Texas after immigration officials accused her of overstaying her visa.  While in detention, Kordia was hospitalized for three days after suffering a seizure and hitting her head at the facility.  Her arrest followed a 2024 Gaza solidarity protest outside Columbia University, where around 100 demonstrators were detained

Today, with the ascension of the family of the late Rani Goili to the grave at the end of the seven days, one of the most terrible and painful periods the people of Israel have known ends. The family, friends, comrades-in-arms and Israeli police officers and many others gathered this morning at the fresh grave of Rani Goili, a hero of Israel and defender of the unknown.   Rani, the last remaining abductee in Gaza, was finally laid to rest - not as we had hoped, but as it had to happen: at home, on his land, surrounded by the love of his family and people.  This is a moment of deep mourning, but also of closing a painful national circle. 255 abductees were returned to Israel. 87 were placed as victims, each one a world and full, each of them an open wound in the hearts of the families and in the heart of the entire country.  The headquarters of the families for the return of the abductees ends its activity with a sense of unrelenting pain for all those who could be with us here today and are not, but also with a clear knowledge: the struggle was waged in the name of the values ​​of the State of Israel and the people of Israel. The values ​​of mutual guarantee, social solidarity and the duty to return home every abductee regardless of religion, race and gender, soldiers and civilians, living or dead.   This historic struggle for their return will be engraved in the national memory as a reminder of the unimaginable human cost of October 7, and of the deep commitment of Israeli society to the families, the missing and the missing. It was also the beautiful hour of the people of Israel who took to the streets en masse, all over the country in the name of these values.  On this day, we will also cherish the soldiers and women of the IDF and all the security forces for a very long and bloody fight. We will send a blessing of recovery to all those wounded in body and soul and we will forever be grateful to all the bereaved families who lost the most precious to them of all. We bow our heads to the Goyili family and to all the families of the martyrs, and pray that we will never have to fight like this again. Ukraine has imposed sanctions against Russian and Iranian companies and citizens who help Russia produce weapons, and 10 Paralympians who fought against Ukraine.  The first package of restrictions included 130 individuals and 48 legal entities. These are companies involved in the supply of components for the production of equipment of the "Comet" series (they are used in Russian drones, cruise and ballistic missiles, guided munitions, and airplanes). The list also includes enterprises involved in the production of the Oreshnik missile complex.  The list also included Iranian companies and citizens involved in the production of drones and missiles, as well as instructors who trained Russian Shahed operators.  In addition, Ukraine initiated a ban on entry into EU countries and the introduction of sanctions against almost 130 Russian commanders involved in crimes against Ukrainians.   @babel
